name: Strawberry Trifle Cups with Lemon Pudding & Whipped Topping

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Pilsbury strawberry cake mix and Jell-O instant lemon pudding mix; if using different brands please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
TO MAKE THE CAKE: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat two 9-inch round cake pans with nonstick cooking spray. Cut parchment paper to fit the bottom of the pans and press into the bottoms.
Place cake mix, eggs, water, and oil in a medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on medium for 2 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (432 g) box strawberry cake mix
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Divide batter between the cake pans and spread out in an even layer. Place in the preheated oven and bake until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean, 19-23 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 1 hour.
TO MAKE THE PUDDING: Meanwhile, place milk and pudding mix in a clean medium bowl. Using a hand-held mixer, blend on low for 2 minutes. Place in the fridge until ready to assemble the trifle cups.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups whole milk
1 (96 g) pkg instant pudding mix, lemon flavored

instructions.primary_message: TO ASSEMBLE THE TRIFLE CUPS: When the cakes are cool, remove one cake from the pan and cut into bite-sized pieces. Return cake pieces to the pan and set aside. (Reserve remaining cake for another use.)
Wash, dry, trim, and halve strawberries lengthwise; thinly slice.

In 12 glass or plastic cups, layer half each of the cake squares, prepared pudding, whipped topping, and sliced strawberries. Repeat layering with remaining cake, pudding, and whipped topping. Decorate the top of each trifle cup, as desired, with the remaining sliced strawberries.
